annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of Ministers of Saudi Arabia (Saudi Data and AI Authority, SDAIA)
key_provisions_or_claims: SDAIA is the national authority and reference for data and AI, with legal personality, linked to the Prime Minister.
Authority sets policies, standards and controls for data and AI sectors and monitors compliance.
Board may license non-government individuals and entities for specified data and AI activities.
Three bodies: National Information Center, National Center for AI, National Data Management Office.
Board approves national strategies, data-sharing requests and governance of finances and organisation.
annotation.summary_en: Organisational arrangements of the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA), issued by Council of Ministers decision 292 (1441 AH) and amended by decision 195 (1444 AH). Defines SDAIA's goals, powers, board, president, three affiliated bodies, finances and its role as national regulator and reference for data and AI.
